yt_text_polls.topic: When does the bottom actually print?
yt_text_polls.question_text:
I am not with the crowd that has the bottom pinned to October.

ADP just printed 8,300 jobs for the week. That is the sixth straight week of slowing and less than half of what it was a month ago. Earlier this year we had the AI layoffs, but new jobs kept replenishing them so it balanced out. Now the layoffs have mostly stopped and almost nothing new is being created, which is the scarier version: if something breaks there is nothing left to replenish it.

Meanwhile manufacturing PMI printed 55.6, the strongest reading since 2022. That contradiction is the whole story right now, and it is why I stopped sitting at a comfortable 50-50.

Here is my honest split: 50% the bottom is already behind us, 40% it prints in the next 30 days, 10% it comes after October.

Where do you land?
yt_text_polls.hook: I am not with the crowd that has the bottom pinned to October.
options: The bottom is already behind us

yt_text_polls.topic: What replaces ElizaOS now that it is dead?
yt_text_polls.question_text:
ElizaOS is done. The foundation is shutting down, the class action settlement drained what was left, and the founder came out and said the token is finished.

People keep asking me what replaces it. Be honest about what it was: in the 2024 run it was the third largest AI token behind $TAO and Virtuals, it had a real software team, an actual platform, and listings almost everywhere. That combination is not sitting on a shelf waiting for somebody to pick it up.

So where does the AI money go now?
